(3) The female voice returns, her tone shifting to be more lighthearted and slightly humorous as she observes her baby's struggle with small physical tasks like holding objects. (4) Another male voice enters, speaking with a slightly higher energy and faster speech rate, sharing a personal anecdote about his son's educational struggles and self-criticism.
